caption: Welcome
text: Welcome to the Group Buy Organiser. This quick tour will show you how to create, launch, and manage your first group buy.

caption: What is a group buy?
text: A group buy combines everyone's orders into one larger supplier order. You manage the process, and the organiser keeps everything in one place.

caption: What we'll cover
text: We'll begin with the Setup Wizard. Then, we'll explore the workspace and the tools you'll use every day. Ready? Let's get started.

caption: The Setup Wizard
text: The Setup Wizard has seven simple steps. Nothing goes live until you launch. As you enter details, a preview will show what your members see.

caption: Basics
text: First, add your group buy name, description, currency, closing date, supplier details, and member limit.

caption: Name your group buy
text: Now, enter a clear name for your group buy. The preview will open and update as you type.

caption: Products
text: Next, add the products your members can order. Each product needs a name, member price, supplier, and available stock.

caption: Add your first product
text: Enter your first product now. The preview will show how its name, price, and availability appear on the member order form.

caption: Shipping
text: Now, add your delivery methods and prices. The preview shows how members choose an option, enter an address, or upload a prepaid label.

caption: Accepting Payments
text: Choose how you'd like to be paid. You can enable one payment method, or offer several.

caption: Direct Crypto
text: Direct crypto lets members pay your wallet. Enter the correct wallet address and network for each coin you accept.

caption: Anon Pay
text: Anon Pay lets members pay with supported crypto, while you receive the currency you selected.

caption: Revolut
text: With Revolut, members pay using your Revtag. Make sure the name and payment instructions are clear.

caption: PayPal
text: With PayPal, members use your payment link. You can also explain which payment type they should select.

caption: Enable a payment method
text: Your turn. Enable at least one payment method and enter its details. The preview will show the instructions your members receive.

caption: Access
text: Access controls who can join. You can add an entry fee, restrict countries, or require a four-digit PIN.

caption: Member preview
text: The preview shows the joining screen your members will see, including any fee, restrictions, or PIN requirement.

caption: Rules and Information
text: Add your welcome message, payment rules, refund information, and disclaimer. Members will read and accept these before ordering.

caption: Review and Launch
text: Review brings everything together. Green means a section is ready. Amber means something is missing. Select Edit to make any changes.

caption: Going live
text: Finally, choose public or private. Public group buys can be discovered. Private group buys can only be opened using the correct link.

caption: The Workspace
text: Welcome to your workspace. The sidebar groups your tools into daily tasks, people, orders, shipping, quality, and setup.

caption: Overview
text: Overview shows your active orders, order value, unpaid members, and orders ready for dispatch. Start here whenever you sign in.

caption: Order Pipeline
text: The order pipeline follows each order through four stages: intake, paid, packing, and dispatched. Choose the view that works best for you.

caption: Tasks
text: Use Tasks to organise your work. Add deadlines, create categories, and link a task directly to an order.

caption: Members
text: Members shows everyone taking part. Select a member to view their orders, payments, spending, and fulfilment history.

caption: Tickets
text: Tickets keeps member questions and problems together. Reply to each message, then update the ticket when the issue is resolved.

caption: Announcements
text: Use Announcements to send group updates. Start with a template, then choose whether to message everyone or a selected group.

caption: Orders
text: Orders is where you manage purchases. Search, filter, edit details, confirm payments, and update each order's status.

caption: Bulk Order Tools
text: Select several orders to update them together. You can also import tracking numbers, or export order data as a C.S.V. file.

caption: Supplier Summary
text: Supplier Summary combines every order into one product list. It shows exactly what you need to purchase from your supplier.

caption: Profit and Loss
text: Profit and Loss compares your revenue with your costs. Add each expense to see your current profit and margin.

caption: Incoming Parcels
text: Add supplier parcels and tracking numbers here. Record what each parcel contains, then follow it until it arrives.

caption: Dispatch
text: Dispatch guides you through receiving stock, preparing member orders, printing labels, and confirming that each parcel has been sent.

caption: Shipping Labels
text: Shipping Labels shows which members supplied a label or Q.R. code, and which members still need a reminder.

caption: Package Forwarders
text: Use Package Forwarders when someone receives a parcel, then sends it onwards to members in another country.

caption: International Routes
text: International Routes tracks each country and hand-off when a parcel travels through several locations or forwarders.

caption: Shipping Rates
text: Shipping Rates is where you manage delivery methods, supported countries, and the prices your members pay.

caption: Vendor Certificates
text: Vendor Certificates stores your supplier's Certificates of Analysis. Record the product, batch, purity, and review status for each certificate.

caption: Lab Testing Pool
text: Use the Lab Testing Pool to organise independent testing, collect member contributions, manage samples, and share the final results.

caption: Settings
text: Settings lets you update the group buy name, dates, capacity, status, access, entry fee, and member notices.

caption: Archive and Delete
text: Archive controls are also inside Settings. Check everything carefully before archiving or permanently deleting a group buy.

caption: Products
text: Return to Products to add items, change prices, update suppliers, manage stock, or import several products at once.

caption: Rules and Information
text: Return to Rules and Information whenever you need to update your welcome message, participation rules, or disclaimer.

caption: Search
text: Need to find something quickly? Use Search, or press Control K on Windows, or Command K on a Mac.

caption: You're ready
text: And that's it. Start with Overview, manage payments in Orders, and use Dispatch when your stock arrives. You can replay this tour whenever you need it.
